candidate_profile.professional_summary: Aspiring Junior Data Engineer with hands-on experience building end-to-end ELT pipelines, cloud-based data warehouses, and scalable data solutions using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and AWS S3. Skilled in data extraction, transformation, validation, and modeling, with additional exposure to Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Neural Networks via Scikit-learn and TensorFlow. Passionate about building reliable, automated data platforms that turn raw data into actionable business insights, with a proven ability to deliver production-like projects individually and in teams.

projects.title: End-to-End Data Engineering Project
projects.description: Designed an end-to-end ELT pipeline implementing Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers). Loaded data from AWS S3 into Snowflake and built dbt transformation models for analytics-ready datasets. Implemented SCD Type 2 and Incremental Models, and performed automated data quality testing to ensure integrity. Designed One Big Table (OBT) and Star Schema data models to support flexible, performant analytics.

projects.title: Energy Data Warehouse ELT Pipeline (DEPI Graduation Project)
projects.description: Built a production-like data warehouse processing the IDEAL dataset covering energy data from 255 UK households. Designed ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load large-scale household energy consumption data. Built Power BI dashboards generating business insights on energy consumption and efficiency for data-driven decisions. Collaborated within a team environment to deliver the project end-to-end on schedule.

projects.title: Python Data Processing Project
projects.description: Automated data processing, cleaning, and filtering in Python to prepare raw datasets for analysis and reporting. Generated reports and reusable processing scripts to standardize repeatable data tasks.
